LINES: This is RSN. We interrupt this broadcast.
這裡是 RSN 新聞網。我們中斷節目插播。
Across three continents, the lights are going out.
橫跨三大洲，燈火正在熄滅。
The first wave came from the sky.
第一波攻擊來自天空。
Cheap drones, by the thousand. No pilots. No warning.
廉價無人機，成千上萬。沒有飛行員，沒有預警。
The second wave came through the banks.
第二波攻擊穿過銀行。
Sanctions froze a nation in ninety seconds.
制裁在九十秒內凍結了一個國家。
Markets fell faster than cities.
市場崩得比城市還快。
Then the missiles.
然後是飛彈。
Power grids. Data centers. Refineries.
電網、資料中心、煉油廠。
The targets were not soldiers. They were systems.
目標不是士兵，而是系統。
Steel still matters. Carriers still sail.
鋼鐵依然重要，航母依然出航。
But wars are no longer won by steel alone.
但戰爭已不再只靠鋼鐵取勝。
Drones. Sanctions. Spies. Alliances.
無人機、制裁、間諜、同盟。
Every weapon is on the table.
每一種武器都已擺上檯面。
Commander, the storm is yours.
指揮官，風暴由你掌控。
